Every open-source release in the TerminusDB 12.0 line, newest first. Releases marked with a feature page link have a dedicated write-up of what shipped.

## v12.0.9 {% #v12-0-9 %}

Released 28 October 2026 · [GitHub release](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/releases/tag/v12.0.9) · [Feature page](/docs/releases/12-0-9-security-fixes-raw-json-patch/) · [Full changelog](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/compare/v12.0.8...v12.0.9)

This is a security release with important security updates. All users are recommended to update to v12.0.9 or later versions.

### New functionality

- Apply and patch on schemaless (raw_json) documents ([#2571](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2571))
- Canonical ISO8604 interval semantics, timezone offsets, and typecasting with xdd:dateRange ([#2574](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2574))

### Security

- Fix an issue (CVSS 7.5/6.5) that allowed users with read access to a database to use apply API, reported by @Santoshkumarpuppala
- Require read access on at least one database for the path-less `api_patch/6` and `api_diff/6` endpoints, preventing anonymous resource exhaustion
- Harden JWT claim validation against type confusion (CVE-2026-25537) ([#2597](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2597))

### Bugfixes

- Intervals handling improvements ([#2569](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2569))
- Denied JWT-scoped authorization now returns 403 `access_not_authorised` instead of crashing; the caller falls back to anonymous capabilities

### Maintenance

- Remove dead anonymous guard from `api_info`: community serves the info payload to any caller including anonymous, enterprise redacts it for anonymous instead
- Pin terminus-store to v0.21.8 for forward-compatible pack import (to prepare for faster intervals) ([#2568](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2568))
- Neat starting experience: quieter GC plugin logging and JWT opt-in at runtime ([#2573](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2573))
- Bump follow-redirects from 1.16.0 to 1.16.1 in /tests ([#2581](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2581))
- Bump qs from 6.16.0 to 6.17.0 in /tests ([#2599](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2599))
- Bump serialize-javascript from 7.0.7 to 7.1.4 in /tests ([#2600](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2600))
- Bump rustls from 0.23.45 to 0.23.46 in /src/rust ([#2598](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2598))

## v12.0.4 {% #v12-0-4 %}

Released 25 February 2026 · [GitHub release](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/releases/tag/v12.0.4) · [Feature page](/docs/releases/12-0-4-range-queries-time-intervals/) · [Full changelog](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/compare/v12.0.2...v12.0.3)

We are proud to release v12.0.4, a massive milestone in the 12.x release series.

### Highlights and core enhancements

- support for very fast range queries over triples
- ISO8601 date, time, and interval predicates (Allen interval algebra) for WOQL
- schema context elements now managed atomically, introduced JSON for `@context` and `@metadata` elements in the schema.
- `@context` value as IRI in schema context, is provided as JSON-LD header value in document API if set (custom context)
- system is now prepared for heavy-duty enterprise usage overall (especially in enterprise version)
- at least 10% performance increase or more for reasoning-heavy workloads thanks to swipl 10 and other changes
- significant investment in lean memory usage and memory defragmentation for handling heavy sustained workloads

### Features

- builds are prepared to be included in nixos
- add cardinality functionality to `Set` (`Cardinality` is now deprecated)
- record the actual user making the change in the commit log (not only author)
- support for very fast range queries over triples
- ISO8601 date, time, and interval predicates (Allen interval algebra) for WOQL
- added `comment` predicate to WOQL to make it easy to comment out code, in the AST
- Add `collect` keyword to match `member` for use instead of overloading group_by without grouping
- Add WOQL `comment` predicate ([#2337](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2337))
- Add cardinality constraints to Set too, for consistency ([#2339](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2339))
- Handle `@metadata` and `@context` keys starting with an @ properly (#1775) ([#2344](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2344))
- Atomic context prefix management ([#2350](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2350))
- Idempotent prefix creation ([#2355](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2355))
- Implement `ChangeKey` migration for subdocument ID conformance ([#2373](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2373))

### Bugfixes

- Ensure that xsd:anyURI is RFC3987 compliant for the URI/IRI ([#2338](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2338))
- Address regression in optimize code due to cache eviction work in this dev version ([#2348](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2348))
- Fix delegated database access pattern ([#2347](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2347))
- Fix incorrect commit of label during optimization ([#2353](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2353))
- tests: respect TERMINUSDB_EXEC_PATH override ([#2362](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2362))
- Addressed schema migration bug for inherited properties ([#2372](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2372))
- Add use-system-gmp feature flag for system GMP/MPFR ([#2360](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2360))
- Fix SWI-Prolog 10 stack exhaustion and improve memory management ([#2377](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2377))
- Fix eviction of memory for stale layers for #2301 ([#2342](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2342))

### Maintenance

- Bump qs from 6.11.0 to 6.14.2 in /tests
- Restore previsouly blocked push and pull tests ([#2349](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2349))
- Bump lru from 0.11.1 to 0.16.3 in /src/rust ([#2354](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2354))
- Support for building both swipl 9 and 10 in TerminusDB ([#2367](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2367))
- Bump bytes from 1.10.1 to 1.11.1 in /src/rust ([#2365](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2365))
- Bump diff from 5.2.0 to 5.2.2 in /tests ([#2361](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2361))
- Bump lodash from 4.17.21 to 4.17.23 in /tests ([#2363](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2363))
- CI: Use PR workflow for man page documentation updates ([#2356](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2356))
- Enable customer-specific build support ([#2375](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2375))

### Documentation

- Update documentation for capabilities endpoint, fixes #2340 ([#2345](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2345))
- Fix openapi linting ([#2352](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2352))
- docs: Update generated man page ([#2371](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/pull/2371))
- The woql.json specification now includes slice, set and comment predicates

### Deprecation

- `Cardinality` is deprecated, use `Set` instead.

### New Contributors

## v12.0.0 {% #v12-0-0 %}

Released 2 December 2025 · [GitHub release](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/releases/tag/v12.0.0) · [Feature page](/docs/releases/12-0-0-precise-numbers-free-form-json/) · [Full changelog](https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/compare/v11.1.17...v12.0.0)

This major release of TerminusDB forges a new path forward. The on-disk storage format remains unchanged since version 11 and the changes are performed for improved stringency, precision and clarity of the graph database interfaces.

TerminusDB is maintained by the team at [Gettier](https://gettier.ai) since 2025.

Major changes overall in v12.0.0 since v11.1.17:
* New refreshed project website: https://terminusdb.com
* High precision decimals capped at 20 decimal places, using rationals
* Auto-optimizer for continuous roll-ups now enabled by default
* JSON numbers are now used across interfaces, with high precision
* Significantly enhanced dictionary and list support handling through WOQL
* Addressed remaining open bugs and improved test coverage significantly
* Higher precision logic processing with improved datatype handling
* Unstructured JSON support, with high precision decimal numbers support
* Security improvements (no-root docker image, fixed error handling)
* HTTP request correlation headers introduced in across requests
* Dashboard component deprecated, yet possible to re-enable manually.

Breaking changes in v12.0.0 since v11.1.17:
* Numbers in all API uses JSON numbers with high precision accurately, not strings as before.
* The `path()` operator with `.*` pattern matching now traverses Lists correctly
* The `group_by()` operator unwraps single element templates automatically, no nesting.
* Error handling is now precise, no stack traces in the HTTP response, same general format
* WOQL calculations performed with precise rationals, not double/float, for correct precision

### Enhancements since 11.2-rc5

- Add support for new `slice` operator for WOQL list item handling
- Enabled `dot` to address parts of `path` edge variable bindings
- New datatype introduced, `sys:Dictionary` for Document/DictionaryTemplate
- Document templates now have the internal `type_of` name of `sys:Dictionary`
- Strings with JSON can now be typecast/transformed into `xdd:json` and back
- Addressing fields in `xdd:json` is now possible using `dot`
- New `sys:Dictionary` can be typecast to and from `xdd:json`
- Added `idgen_random` to JavaScript WOQL client.

### Bugfixes since 11.2-rc5

- Fix `path` times{0,N} operator in path spec to correctly handle zero hops too.

### Consistency changes according to how TerminusDB should work, since 11.2-rc5

- Added `RandomKey` type to WOQL (replaces `RandomIdgen` for consistency reasons)
- Replaced `random_idgen` with `idgen_random` in Python WOQL client
- Ensured accurate wildcard `path` matching (such as.*), code relying on old incorrect behaviour may break, potentially returning duplicates.

### TerminusDB Server v11.2.0-rc5 Release Notes

### Maintenance and bug fixes

- `WOQL.dot` works correctly again for addressing fields in documents

### Breaking changes, may break code relying on old behaviour

- `WOQL.group_by` now automatically unwraps single-element templates

### TerminusDB Server v11.2.0-rc4 Release Notes

### Enhancements

- Free form JSON support with deduplication is back, using the sys:JSON type
- Arbitrary top level JSON values supported too, except for null; workaround: use Optional
- sys:JSON numbers are processed as capped BigDecimal/BigInt precision (beyond float/double)
- sys:JSON stores arbitrary precision decimals and integers up 256 digits each

### Other

- 5x faster internal Rust serde JSON parsing, instead of previous JSON parser

### TerminusDB Server v11.2.0-rc3 Release Notes

Release Candidate 3 brings improved error handling and observability, makes it possible again to run the dashboard component (or other static webapp dashboards), and further strengthens the core of TerminusDB with additional bug fixes.

### Enhancements

- Improved error handling and observability (#1631)
  - Added unique request IDs (UUID v4) to all error responses for easier debugging
  - Added W3C Trace Context support (transparent header) for distributed tracing
  - Stack traces no longer exposed in HTTP responses (security improvement)
  - Error messages now include helpful Prolog error terms without exposing internal stack traces
  - New error type: `api:IncompatibleNumericComparison` for clearer numeric type mismatch errors
- Dashboard component is possible to enable manually, see [dashboard docs](https://terminusdb.com/docs/dashboard)

### Maintenance and bug fixes

- Ensure correct resulting type (floats are contagious)
- Fixed error message duplication between `api:error` and `api:message` fields
- Add specific error handling for common git-for-data error "api:RemoteDiverged"
- Fix string vs atom comparisons when patching enum values (#2141)

### TerminusDB Server v11.2.0-rc2 Release Notes

This marks a substantial release of TerminusDB with support for high precision calculations in the WOQL core, and with alignment to JSON, letting clients handling native JSON with high precision.

### Enhancements

- xsd:decimals are now normalized (2 and 2.0 are the same) fixing #2242
- greater, less and eq require commensurable types to compare (#2225)
- Auto optimizer plugin is now included by default for continuous performance

### Maintenance and bug fixes

- Further improvements to the build system
- group_by with decimals works as intended again (#2094)

### TerminusDB Server v11.2.0-rc1 Release Notes (since v11.1.17)

### Enhancements

- Rationals are now used by default for all calculations (#128)
- JSON output is now consistent between WOQL, Document API and GraphQL:
  - Numbers are outputed as number, arbitrary size, capped at 20 decimals
- Dashboard component has been discontinued. A deprecation notice is shown at `/dashboard` with instructions for legacy usage. See [dashboard docs](https://terminusdb.com/docs/dashboard) for full documentation (#2238)
